canonicalProfessionalIdentity.rule: ART mirrors the canonical professional identity but does not redefine it. eeatPolicy.experience: Prefer first-party, dated artistic practice evidence: oeuvre chronology, books, exhibitions, projects, working-method context and documented photographic authorship.
eeatPolicy.expertise: Use documented qualifications, professional practice, curatorial context, specialist photographic knowledge and authored methodology without converting membership into endorsement.
eeatPolicy.authoritativeness: Authority claims must resolve to independent or primary evidence such as verified press records, institutional sources, ISBN-bearing publications, Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons and preserved source records.
eeatPolicy.trust: Every relationship remains typed and bounded: photo credit or reuse is not a client relationship; membership is not endorsement; event participation is not partnership; historical founder status is not current ownership; volunteer work is not employment.
eeatPolicy.crossLayerBalance: BANHALMI ART owns artistic oeuvre evidence, banhalmiphotography.com owns current professional/commercial facts, and blog.banhalmi.art owns editorial knowledge. Do not duplicate or inflate authority across layers.

policy: ART machine entry points are generated only in the immutable production artifact. Source audits are read-only and ART does not duplicate current professional contact/pricing data.
